messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to help students get to know a new 先生 teacher.

One True or False Your teacher has never been to another country False they visited 日本.

Two True or False Your teacher speaks more than two languages True they speak English and フランス.

Three True or False Your teacher's favorite food is pizza False they actually prefer to eat 寿司.

Four True or False Your teacher has a pet cat False they actually have a big 犬.

Five True or False Your teacher is a great athlete False they are actually a big 音楽 fan.

Six True or False Your teacher has visited all seven continents False they missed one 南極.

Seven True or False Your teacher has a middle name True their middle name is actually 名前.

Eight True or False Your teacher is afraid of heights False they are actually afraid of 蜘蛛.

These questions are great for building excitement and helping students bond with their new teacher from 最初 day of school.
